newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Electric interim profits down on rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Electric interim profits down on rate cut.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc announced an interim profit drop of more than 50 percent on Wednesday, due mainly to a power rate cut earlier this year.
Japan's largest power company posted 2.5 trillion yen ($22.5 billion) in sales in the first half of the current business year, down 2.1 percent from the same period last year.
Its parent current profit for the six months to September 30 fell 50.8 percent to 61.7 billion yen ($555 million).
Current profit is pretax and includes gains and losses made on securities investments and other non-operating activities.
In January, the company reduced its power rates by an average of 3.34 percent in response to falling fuel costs due to a strong yen against the dollar at the time.
The cut reduced half-year revenues by 87 billion yen ($783 million) compared with the year earlier.
However, fuel costs increased during the first half amid the yen's retreat against the dollar and a rise in oil prices.
As a result, profitability declined, a company spokesman said.
In the April-September period, the average yen exchange rate was 108.29 yen to the dollar, compared with 89.26 yen in the same period a year ago.
Crude oil prices, meanwhile, averaged $19.86 per barrel in the period, up from $18.41, the firm said.
It revised upward its earnings forecast for the full year and now expects sales of around 5.05 trillion yen ($45.4 billion) and a parent current profit of about 150 billion yen ($1.35 billion).
"The decline in half-year profit was not as grave as we had expected. It was because we had fairly strong sales and increased nuclear power generation," the spokesman said.
Other Japanese regional power companies also announced their interim results on Wednesday.

Kyushu Electric Power Co Inc reported 704 billion yen ($6.34 billion) in sales, down 2.6 percent from the year-ago period, and 30 billion yen ($270 million) in parent current profit, down 22.7 percent.
Shikoku Electric Power Co Inc posted sales of 273 billion yen ($2.45 billion), down 4.1 percent, and parent current profit of 17 billion yen ($153 million), down 18.9 percent. ($1=111 yen)
